title: Makita TW001GM204 40V Max XGT Cordless Impact Wrench 3/4 Inch Drive 1800 Nm Brushless Motor with 2 x 4.0Ah Batteries, Charger & Carrying Case
description: The Makita TW001GM204 40V Max XGT Cordless Impact Wrench is a high-performance 3/4 inch drive tool engineered for professionals handling extreme fastening and loosening tasks. Powered by Makita’s advanced 40V Max XGT lithium-ion system, this impact wrench delivers exceptional power, durability, and control for heavy-duty industrial, construction, automotive, and infrastructure applications. At its core is a high-efficiency brushless motor that produces up to 1,800 N·m of maximum fastening torque and an impressive 2,050 N·m of nut-busting torque. The 3/4 inch (19 mm) square drive with C-ring socket retention is designed to handle large fasteners with confidence. Fastening capacity includes standard bolts from M12 to M36 and high-strength bolts from M10 to M27, making it suitable for a wide range of demanding jobs. The electronically controlled brushless motor optimizes battery energy usage, allowing longer runtime per charge while running cooler and extending overall tool life. This makes the tool ideal for continuous heavy-duty operation without performance drop-off. For superior control and safety, the impact wrench features electronic 4-stage impact power selection with adjustable no-load speeds of up to 1,800 RPM and impact rates of up to 2,500 impacts per minute, depending on the selected mode. Three reaction-time auto stop modes are available in both forward and reverse rotation. The reverse rotation auto stop mode automatically stops the tool once the bolt or nut is sufficiently loosened, reducing the risk of bolt drop and damage to components. The compact overall length of approximately 217 mm improves maneuverability and balance, while the ergonomically designed handle with rubberized soft grip ensures comfort during extended use. A trigger switch with full-speed mode allows the tool to reach maximum speed with less trigger pull, helping reduce hand and finger fatigue. The electric brake stops rotation quickly and smoothly, allowing faster transition between operations. Designed for tough jobsite conditions, XPT Extreme Protection Technology enhances resistance against dust and dripping water, making the tool suitable for outdoor and harsh environments. Twin LED job lights with pre-glow and after-glow functions provide excellent visibility of the socket and work area. An additional LED positioned above the battery ensures clear illumination even when using large sockets such as M27 and above. The tool operates at sound pressure levels of approximately 100 dB(A) and sound power levels of 111 dB(A), with a vibration level of 18.5 m/s² during maximum-capacity impact tightening. Net weight ranges from 3.9 to 4.2 kg depending on the battery used, offering a strong balance between power and handling. This complete professional kit includes 2 x 40V Max XGT 4.0Ah lithium-ion batteries, a 40V rapid charger, a durable carrying case, a shoulder strap, and a metal belt clip for added convenience on the job. WARRANTY DETAILS The tool is covered by a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. The batteries and charger are covered by a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects.
